sloka: अत्यर्थम् सक्त मनसो रावणे ता वर स्त्रियः ।अस्वतन्त्राः सपत्नीनाम् प्रियम् एव आचरमः तदा ॥५-९-५९॥
transliteration: atyartham sakta manaso rāvaṇe tā vara striyaḥ ।asvatantrāḥ sapatnīnām priyam eva ācaramaḥ tadā ॥5-9-59॥

translations.english: Even though the beautiful wives (should have been angry with their cowives for smelling their mouths) they behaved pleasingly, having no freedom to act with Ravana
